title: Personal Forecasting Dashboard Consistency
dataSources: Forecasts (`forecast:personal`), journal reviews (`forecast:journal`), resolved outcomes (`forecast:resolution`), calibration scores (`forecast:calibration`), ops reviews (`forecast:ops`).
app: Personal forecasting telemetry — Metaculus personal predictions, private prediction-journal entries, and calibration-bin scoring — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=forecast:ops dashboard_name=* data_current=*
| stats count as total, sum(eval(if(data_current="yes",1,0))) as matched by dashboard_name
| eval current_data_pct=round(100*matched/total,1)
| sort - current_data_pct
description: Measures the percentage of forecasting dashboards that end with current data by dashboard.
value: Completion and exception percentages make it easier to spot which dashboard are helping or hurting forecasting dashboards.
implementation: Store a normalized flag for `current data` on `forecast:ops` events and summarize the hit rate by `dashboard_name`.
visualization: Table of dashboard with percentage of forecasting dashboards ending with current data.
grandmaExplanation: It builds how often current data happens for each dashboard so you can see where forecasting dashboards go smoothly or get stuck.
